text.text_excerpt: Upon my entrance from the service road, I was greeted with a familiar image... Elsie the Cow... #howiLOVEher... she's a familiar part of my childhood and although lactose-intolerant, I still enjoy the memories invoked by the mere sight of her. Ok, nostalgia over, on to the review... I was/am pleased as pie that this location has opened, as I am no longer forced to drive 5 miles to the nearby R*uses or the down right dirty, filthy, W*nn D*xie... I can casually drive to NEW ORLEANS EAST & gather a few items (or more than a few, as always is the case). New to the area, Post-K, this WalMart is great for revitalization of the area, the economy & rebounding of the WalMart brand in this area. Al...

A brand new Walmart with a Garden Center, Optical and groceries? The Residents of New Orleans East(myself included) are pleased to finally have this convenience. The location on Bullard is also an improvement when compared to the old location next to Bunker Hill 0__o The overall order of this location is impressive: items re-shelved to uniform, empty spaces restocked, shopping carts collected and restored, staff being proactive "How can I help you?". Keep it up!

At Last!!! Walmart Inc. has finally joined the new orleans east area with a spankin' brand new store! I must admit I wasn't impressed when I initially heard they were adding a location to our area but after watching how this store added value to the neighborhood, I became increasingly excited. The store had an official grand opening with spotlights, news reporters, et cetera.. The staff was uber friendly and the store was packed with locals. The aisles were busy and checkout lines were long but the staff was efficient with handling the crowds. The shelves were emptying quickly and the staff was quickly filling them.
